back_story: Tommy Vercetti did fifteen years for a mob hit, then got sent to Vice City to broker a drug deal that went sideways in a hail of gunfire. Double-crossed, stripped of cash and cargo, he rebuilt himself from a disposable soldier into the man who owns the city. Under the pink-neon dusk of 1986, a hoodlum's revenge became an empire.

curation.zh: 汤米为黑手党顶罪入狱十五年，被派到罪恶城做交易却遭埋伏。他从一枚弃子杀回巅峰，最终掌控全城。80 年代粉色霓虹下，暴徒的复仇长成帝国。
curation.en: Tommy did 15 years, got double-crossed in Vice City, and came back to own the whole town. The 1986 neon-noir origin story.
